setup: The burned L-shaped foundation, granite notch, chest recess and pristine west shelf share exact geography.
initial_audience_interpretation: The ruin belonged to whoever made the portal, while the earlier shelf offers a new start.
payoff: Terrain and efficient survival choices lead the protagonist to build the same cabin whose remains he saw.
notes: Use matched coordinates and lenses; do not rely on narration alone.

setup: A complete active frame stands in a private region the protagonist has not previously visited.
initial_audience_interpretation: The portal has an absent but unknown builder.
payoff: After Moss dies, the protagonist mines and places every block of the exact frame.
notes: Builder identity must resolve through construction before the activation reversal.

setup: The frame has an asymmetrical cobblestone foot, exposed lava and a surviving spruce remnant.
initial_audience_interpretation: They are rough repair, blast debris or accidental activation evidence.
payoff: Water cooling creates the foot, the protagonist places the ignition cradle, and the blast releases lava to its surviving plank.
notes: Every block requires an ordinary material origin and stable final coordinate.

setup: Moss routinely sits beside the bed only while the protagonist works near ravine lava.
initial_audience_interpretation: It is a sensible command that keeps the wolf out of mining danger.
payoff: The same routine leaves Moss unable to self-evacuate while the protagonist begins below the burning cabin.
notes: No pen, doghouse, locked room or autonomous rule change may replace the sit mechanic.

setup: The cold open cuts as the protagonist reaches through fire towards Moss.
initial_audience_interpretation: The rescue may still succeed because he clearly prioritises the wolf.
payoff: The completed action reaches Moss after the terminal fire-damage interval.
notes: The cut withholds outcome honestly; narration cannot assert survival or death early.

setup: A stone-clad interruption in the burned stair appears to have been a firebreak, while a stripped-log seam passes behind it in the intact build.
initial_audience_interpretation: The stone should prevent lava fire from reaching the cabin.
payoff: Lateral lava reaches the concealed continuous support and bypasses the visible cladding.
notes: Mechanical geometry and visual legibility need target-version testing.

setup: The protagonist carries one movable water source and packs to leave rather than defend the cabin.
initial_audience_interpretation: Water may be sufficient because he has planned for the known hazard.
payoff: He spends the water solely on reaching Moss, but separated fire and distance consume the available time.
notes: The limitation is coverage and timing, not an invented ban on collecting water.

setup: Cooling the shelf produces local obsidian while the future portal frame remains absent.
initial_audience_interpretation: The blocks may offer a controlled route home after the hazard is removed.
payoff: He carries the same mined obsidian into the cave and builds the remembered economical frame.
notes: No obsidian or other physical material is bootstrapped.

setup: The opening portal cave has a dark lateral branch and the later rescue water washes its torch away.
initial_audience_interpretation: The darkness is minor environmental continuity.
payoff: A creeper approaches through that branch while the protagonist watches the ignition cradle.
notes: Confirm approach and light-level logic; do not assert an untested spawn beside the player.

setup: No body or meaningful dropped token remains beside the opening blast cavity.
initial_audience_interpretation: The builder may have escaped or left no useful evidence.
payoff: The creeper kills the protagonist and ordinary drops are consumed by nearby lava or fire before the later discovery.
notes: Do not invent a wolf collar drop, corpse object or non-vanilla clue.

setup: The opening frame is active despite blast damage and no surviving flint-and-steel evidence.
initial_audience_interpretation: The explosion may seem to have lit it directly.
payoff: The blast breaks the retaining lip; lava ignites remaining spruce and a later fire block activates the frame.
notes: Explicitly preserve the distinction between explosion, geometry change, fire spread and portal activation.

setup: An ordinary-looking frame routes the protagonist to the same ravine before the frame exists.
initial_audience_interpretation: The builder reveal may also explain where the temporal design originated.
payoff: The protagonist is the physical builder and activator, but the first external origin of the copied temporal routing remains unanswered.
intentionally_open_reason: The information loop supports the authorship mystery and is not needed to explain materials, fire, death or activation.
notes: Open status remains unlocked pending human approval.
